'''Selvia''' is a NPC from (Bariura GQ). She is the First Imperial Princess of Bariura Empire, as well as the oldest child of the Emperor of Bariura.

==History==

Selvia remains inside the castle during the Great War, preparing things to depart to [[Vilanciel|another world]]. At a point, she orders [[Melina (character)|Melina]] to spread the rumor that the Emperor disappeared, in order to call[[Sirius (character)| her brother]] back. She also entrusts a bracelet, her heirloom, to [[Berdette (character)|Berdette]], asking [[Feleen (character)|Feleen]] to deliver it to the Third Princess in the middle of the war. When Sirius arrives at the castle, Selvia asks him about his decision. At first, Sirius was still hesitant, but Selvia forces him to go by saying that if they don't defend the Empire, then there is nothing left to protect. Afterward, Sirius has no other choice but to obey his older sister. Selvia then accompanies her father and younger brother to Vilanciel. It is implied that Selvia is the one who made Balamgram.

===Brave Frontier Heroes===
The eldest imperial princess of the Bariura Empire. Despite possessing the qualities of an exceptional ruler, Selvia was denied the opportunity to inherit the throne simply because she was a woman. Nevertheless, she never revealed her emotions about this and diligently served as the right-hand of her father, Emperor Theodorus. Due to her efforts, those in key positions had immense trust in her character. Contrary to her slender and delicate appearance, it is said that she wielded a greatsword as tall as herself with a single hand, effortlessly slashing through the battlefield.

*In her last scene in the gold achievement route, it is revealed that Selvia once saved Feleen's life, and thus gained Feleen's loyalty to her.
